title: Open-extension record from supplied normalized restriction
statement: Given a normalized open restriction package Rj whose Frobenius comparison is zlFrobeniusSquare, construct the open-extension clause ZlOpenExtension relative to its supplied comparison and local-operator data. This asserts only the extension clause and does not construct or choose the restriction package.

source.place: Restriction paragraph and Part 2, extension-by-zero sentence

proof.text: Obtain the normalized open action and t-exactness from lem-zl-open-extension-texact-coefficient-stages and its adjunction, Weil unit and empty-fibre equations from lem-zl-open-weil-unit-and-empty-fibre. Use lem-zl-texact-fixed-pair-heart-cohomology and the supplied restriction operation to lift the normalized open cohomology comparisons and prove exactness. Transport the Weil unit along hRj. Invert the restriction stalk equation and use naturality of the inverse unit for inside stalks. Geometric disjointness and the canonical scalar/homology comparison transport empty-fibre cohomology zero to the recorded outside stalk. Assemble all open-extension fields.
